descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Western Digital WD Blue SN5000 1TB M.2 NVMe PCIe SSD


Specifications:

Capacity: 1TB

Form Factor: M.2 2280

Interface: PCIe Gen4 x4

Protocol: NVMe 1.4

NAND Flash: 3D NAND

Controller: WD In-House Controller

Sequential Read Speed: Up to ~5,000 MB/s

Sequential Write Speed: Up to ~4,200 MB/s

Random Read (4KB): High IOPS performance

Random Write (4KB): High IOPS performance

Operating Temperature: 0°C – 70°C

Shock Resistance: Yes (typical SSD durability)

MTBF: ~1.75 Million Hours


Key Features:

PCIe Gen4 high-speed performance

Fast boot and application loading

Excellent for gaming, content creation, and productivity

Efficient power use and thermal performance

Reliable WD build quality
